Draw 1 & end turn   F12

VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.name: Draw 2 & End - only epic - draw3 checked (epic) and will suspend end turn

VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.whileExpression: {ShF12==1 && PlayerSide=~"(Pl.*|Solitaire)"}

Draw 2 immediately if deck > 1 cards left (P1)
VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.whileExpression: {doDraw2P1A==1 && gCardsInDrawDeck>1}

VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.whileExpression: {doDraw2P1B==1 && gCardsInDrawDeck==1}

VASSAL.build.module.GlobalKeyCommand.name: Draw Command Card - Player 1
VASSAL.build.module.GlobalKeyCommand.reportFormat: {isOpposed ? cDraw+cSide1+" "+PlayerName+" draws a Command Card to Player 1's hand *":""}

VASSAL.build.module.GlobalKeyCommand.name: Draw 2 Command Cards Epic - Player 1
VASSAL.build.module.GlobalKeyCommand.reportFormat: $cDraw$$cSide1$ $PlayerName$ draws 2 Command Cards to Player 1's hand *

VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.name: Draw 1 with shuffle if need be (P2)

VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.whileExpression: {doDraw2P2A==1 && gCardsInDrawDeck>1}

VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.name: Draw 2x1 P2 if deck has 1 card left only, discard/shuffle in between
VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.whileExpression: {doDraw2P2B==1 && gCardsInDrawDeck==1}

VASSAL.build.module.GlobalKeyCommand.name: Draw Command Card - Player 2
VASSAL.build.module.GlobalKeyCommand.reportFormat: {isOpposed ? cDraw+cSide2+" "+PlayerName+" draws a Command Card to Player 2's hand *":""}

VASSAL.build.module.GlobalKeyCommand.name: Draw 2 Command Cards - Player 2
VASSAL.build.module.GlobalKeyCommand.reportFormat: $cDraw$$cSide2$ $PlayerName$ draws 2 Command Cards to Player 2's hand *

VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.name: card sound, then mute; for multiple draws

VASSAL.build.module.GlobalKeyCommand.reportFormat: {gMute ? "" : cDraw+ GetProperty("cSide"+gDrawFor) +" "+PlayerName+" draws a " + (gDraw3Required ? "face up " : "") + "Command Card to Player "+gDrawFor+" slot "+ GetProperty("cSoloSlot"+gNextSlot)+" *"}

VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.name: alternate key for draw 1 (or Epic draw3) /end
If I Am Spartacus is discarded in a Draw 3 cards, shuffle still happens
VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.reportFormat: End turn: I am Spartacus reshuffle (Draw 3 rule)...
VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.whileExpression: {chkDiscardedSpartacus==1 && Count("{DeckName==gDiscardPile && BasicName=~\"I Am Sp.*\"}","Main Map")>0}

VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.name: End Turn with unlock & check for Spartacus discarded (only happens in Epic)
End Turn epic alternative to Order 1's draw3 - otherwise ignored
VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.whileExpression: {altF12==1 && activeSide == gLastPlayed && !isBackTurnEpic && PlayerSide=~"(Pl.*|Sol.*)" && Count("{CurrentZone=~\".* Card\" && activeCard=~\"Order 1.*\" && ObscuredToOthers==false}","Main Map")>0}

VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.name: End Turn / draw2: epic alternative to Order 1's draw3 - otherwise ignored
VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.whileExpression: {altShiftF12==1 && activeSide == gLastPlayed && !isBackTurnEpic && PlayerSide=~"(Pl.*|Sol.*)" && Count("{CurrentZone=~\".* Card\" && activeCard=~\"Order 1.*\" && ObscuredToOthers==false}","Main Map")>0}

VASSAL.build.module.ToolbarMenu.tooltip: In-game options (see Preferences...Game Options for persistent personal settings)

VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.name: F10 clicks & toggles lost blocks display for all users
VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.tooltip: Show/hide lost blocks (displays to all participants)

{F10==1 && (PlayerSide=~"(Pl.*|Solitaire)" ? true : Alert("Public lost blocks display control is reserved to players.
See Preferences...Game Options for personal display option.")==true)}

VASSAL.build.module.ToolbarMenu.description: Clock controls - if re-enabled: set up the controlling GP blank and set per gClocksSetupOff at game start
VASSAL.build.module.ToolbarMenu.menuItems: NOPause / Restart [F8],NO<html>Setup: Clocks <b><font color=green>On,NO<html>Setup: Clocks <b><font color=red>Off

VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.name: Game clocks turn on - front end (works around spurious line feed vassal bug)
VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.whileExpression: {PlayerSide=~"Pl.*|Sol.*" ? ClockOn==1 : Alert("<html>Game clocks are controlled from lead player roles.</html>")}

VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.name: Game clocks on - backend
VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.reportFormat: $htmlClocksOn$ $PlayerId$ enables game clocks for this game *

VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.name: Game clocks turn off - front end
VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.whileExpression: {PlayerSide=~"Pl.*|Sol.*" ? ClockOff==1 : Alert("<html>Game clocks are controlled from lead player roles.</html>")}

VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.name: Game clocks off
VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.reportFormat: $htmlClocksOff$ $PlayerId$ disables game clocks for this game *

VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.name: Game clocks pause/restart- front end
VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.whileExpression: {PlayerSide=~"P.*|Sol.*" ? ClockPause==1 : Alert("<html>Game clocks are controlled from player roles.</html>")}

VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.name: Restart if paused - Phase 1 - report
VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.tooltip: Manual restart of a paused clock will put the button out of sync (press twice to re-sync)

VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.name: Restart clock phase2 actions (seperate due to Vassal spurious line feed bug)
Enable Face Down deck (also disables revealing names of cards placed on the discard pile)
VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.whileExpression: {flipDiscard==1 && (PlayerSide=~"(Pl.*|Solitaire)" ? true : Alert("Connect to a side to select this game setup option.")==true)}

VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.name: Enable Solo Method
VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.whileExpression: {solo==1 && (PlayerSide=="Solitaire" ? true : Alert("Connect as Solitaire to select this game setup option.")==true)}

VASSAL.build.module.RandomTextButton.faces: Players may draw their initial hands in one go. Check out the button on each Player Hand toolbar.,Have you tried the Tutorial? See Help menu.,Combat accelerator hotkeys also detect and facilitate leader casualty checks!,To show or hide your hand window\, press the Escape key or\, during a game\, click on your side's card icon.,Command Size is displayed in the card icon on that player's side of the board. Mouseover the icon for more information.,Hidden hotkey ⌥Q will generate another quote or module tip.,Several features can be tailored to your needs via Preferences...Game Options tab.,Sound is optional and can be turned on or off for this module on the Preferences...Sounds tab.,Draw & end turn with one press of the button from the main toolbar.,To draw an extra card (special rules)\, use the button in your player hand. ,The Help toolbar menu lists several useful resources for playing the game and using this module.,Zoom the map using hotkeys ⌃[ and ⌃]. To quickly adjust a map view in its window\, try the "fit" options under the magnifying glass toolbar button.,Find Victory Banner & other special blocks on the terrain palette [F4].,Short of an opponent? Try the CDG Solo System! Start a game as Solitaire. See Help... for solo rules and playsheet.
VASSAL.build.module.RandomTextButton.name: Alexander...

VASSAL.build.module.RandomTextButton.faces: "Veni\, vedi\, vici" - try for yourself in scenario 316!,"Alea iacta est" - randomly\, by Jove! ,"Gallia est pacata" - you can find several Alesia scenarios from commandsandcolors.net using File...Choose Scenario.,Multiple hits can be applied by one button or key press. See the combat toolbar menu,Press F1 to pull up the charts window. See Help...Module Hotkeys for other useful shortcuts.,To detach a leader without marking the unit\, right-click on the leader piece and select the special command "Detach Leader" (shortcut: ⌥D).,Combat actions can be performed by hotkeys or toolbar menu (no piece selected). See Help...Module Hotkeys and the combat toolbar menu.,Click-o-matic: An unintentional marker is automatically removed when another unit is ordered or marked as an attacker.,After playing a card\, left-click on a unit or its attached leader to order that unit. Click on an ordered or enemy unit or attached leader to place combat markers. [Preferences...Game Options: Click-o-matic],See Help...Module User's Guide for detailed information about the module.,Use left-arrow to access a unit and its right-click menu beneath an attached leader.,The game clocks option keeps approximate track of each side's playing time during an online game. Press F8 to pause clocks. Clicking on a clock will switch the timer over (normally automatic).,Visit the module home page from the Help menu to check that you have the latest version.,Players should use the same versions of Vassal and the module for the most reliable experience.
VASSAL.build.module.RandomTextButton.name: Caesar...

VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.name: Tip hotkey from end turn - optional - every 5 turns, alternating sides.
VASSAL.build.module.DoActionButton.whileExpression: {ghkEndTurnFetchTip==1 && (gTurn/5 %3 ==0)}
